name: use-mask
title: Use Mask
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: useMask: applies an input-masks preset ("cpf", "phone", { type: "decimal", prefix: "R$ " }…) or custom Maskito options to any input. Spread `inputProps` onto Input, InputGroupInput or a native input; it carries the masked value, Maskito's ref, and per-preset inputMode, autoComplete and placeholder. Reports the raw value through onValueChange, accepts a raw or masked controlled value, and reads the value of an enclosing react-aria TextField.
